Embedded SIM cards in upcoming phones may be a bad idea.

Embedded SIM cards in upcoming phones may very well mean that the phones may not be able to be used internationally, as they're pretty much stuck with whatever service is embedded on the non-removable card.

For me, my job requires me to travel overseas occasionally and my phone service doesn't offer service in a lot of the countries that I end up going to. Having a phone with an embedded SIM means that I won't be able to switch out the SIM with one that works internationally or with the local network of the country that I'm in.

In short: Non-removable SIM's = BAD for travelers.
